analysis.analysis: 'The Constitution of the Semantic Economy is the foundational governance instrument and canonical framework for managing the value, creation, and circulation of meaning in the digital and algorithmic age.' Shows semantic gravity/density quadrant diagram. Expanded: 'Rather than reducing information costs, this framework seeks to maximize the generation of informational value across networked systems and large language models (LLMs).' Foundational Architecture: 'Meaning as Labor — operates on the premise that meaning is produced by deliberate labor and has a measurable cost.'
